description: This Java test file contains unit tests for the AmqpAdapterSaslAuthenticatorFactory class, specifically verifying SASL authentication behaviors and connection limit handling within the Eclipse Hono AMQP adapter.

classes.name: AmqpAdapterSaslAuthenticatorFactoryTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the behavior of AmqpAdapterSaslAuthenticatorFactory, focusing on SASL handshake outcomes and connection limit enforcement.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes mocks and test fixtures before each test, setting up dependencies and default behaviors.

methods.name: getPlainCredentials
methods.description: Creates a Buffer containing SASL PLAIN credentials given a username and password.

methods.name: getSasl
methods.description: Mocks a Sasl object with specified credentials and mechanisms for testing.

methods.name: testHandshakeFailsIfTenantLevelConnectionLimitIsExceeded
methods.description: Test that verifies the SASL handshake fails with outcome AUTH when tenant connection limit is exceeded.

methods.name: testHandshakeFailsIfAdapterLevelConnectionLimitIsExceeded
